I came to get a molar filled because my old filling, over 30 years old, had cracked and fallen out. I called to make an appointment in advance for Tuesday at 2 PM. There were no available slots. The staff, including the cleaning lady and security guard who helped direct me to the main road, were very welcoming and attentive. I waited about 10 minutes before getting my tooth done.

Dr. Supavit Tasnameethee was meticulous, examining the tooth thoroughly and finding additional decay under the old filling. He removed the remaining filling material and replaced the entire tooth. It took very little time, about 20 minutes in total. My upper and lower teeth fit together perfectly afterwards; nothing protruded. I didn't experience any sensitivity or pain during the procedure, even though I was prepared for it 😊 (Part of it, besides the doctor's skill and expertise, might be because it wasn't too close to a nerve, I don't know). This time, I chose amalgam filling again; it's silver, not aesthetically pleasing, but durable and less likely to crack or fall out.

The staff suctioned my saliva. The dentist was very attentive and provided excellent care.

The filling for one tooth (two sides) cost 2150 baht. I used my social security benefits for 900 baht, leaving me with 1250 baht to pay.

Thank you so much to the doctor and all the staff. I was very impressed. 🥰
